mapper.sql: r.id, r.batch_id, r.round_no, r.title, r.status, r.start_at, r.end_at, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM supplement_intent si WHERE si.round_id = r.id) AS intent_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM offer o WHERE o.batch_id = r.batch_id AND o.round_no = r.round_no AND o.source IN ('SUPPLEMENT', 'PROMOTION') AND o.status IN ('OFFERED', 'CONFIRMED')) AS offer_count
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO supplement_round (batch_id, round_no, title, status, start_at, end_at, created_by) VALUES (#{batchId}, #{roundNo}, #{title}, #{status}, #{startAt}, #{endAt}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM supplement_round r WHERE r.id = #{id}
SELECT FROM supplement_round r WHERE r.batch_id = #{batchId} AND r.round_no = #{roundNo}
SELECT FROM supplement_round r WHERE r.batch_id = #{batchId} AND r.status = 'OPEN' ORDER BY r.round_no DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE supplement_round SET status = #{status}, start_at = IFNULL(#{startAt}, start_at), end_at = IFNULL(#{endAt}, end_at) WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.sql: SELECT si.*, s.student_no, s.name AS student_name, s.major, s.class_name, m.name AS mentor_name, m.title AS mentor_title, m.lab_id, m.quota AS mentor_quota, m.research_direction, l.name AS lab_name, l.total_quota AS lab_quota, r.round_no FROM supplement_intent si JOIN supplement_round r ON r.id = si.round_id JOIN student s ON s.id = si.student_id JOIN mentor m ON m.id = si.mentor_id JOIN lab l ON l.id = m.lab_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO supplement_intent (round_id, batch_id, student_id, mentor_id, sort_no, status, waitlist_rank, comment) VALUES (#{roundId}, #{batchId}, #{studentId}, #{mentorId}, #{sortNo}, #{status}, #{waitlistRank}, #{comment})
mapper.select: WHERE si.round_id = #{roundId} AND si.student_id = #{studentId} AND si.mentor_id = #{mentorId}
WHERE si.round_id = #{roundId} AND si.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY si.sort_no
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM supplement_intent WHERE round_id = #{roundId} AND student_id = #{studentId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM supplement_intent WHERE round_id = #{roundId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM supplement_round WHERE batch_id = #{batchId}
